packages.name: cn.mcd7.neglectdream.dsh-pet
packages.comment: Zero runtime dependencies. Backend uses node/bun built-ins; UI contains audited MIT bubble source/presets but no third-party runtime library. The 114 WebP animations and existing duck sound retain their upstream asset licences, not the MIT code licence.

packages.name: DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget
packages.comment: Reviewed bubble geometry, text presets and styling only; no upstream GIF, PNG, audio or fonts are included. See ui/bubble-presets.json and source audit for exclusions. Not a runtime dependency.

packages.name: FFmpeg
packages.comment: BUILD-TIME ONLY. Never shipped and never invoked at runtime: the release process uses it to decode VP9-with-alpha webm and encode animated WebP. Installing this plugin does not require ffmpeg on the machine.
